MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Alexa-controlled lighting feels like a useful next step because it adds something I can do with the Echo devices I already use.",
    "The Creative Pebble speakers fit my ongoing interest in practical computer accessories, provided their connections work with my setup.",
    "A larger Echo display and a water-resistant portable speaker appeal for their added capabilities, although neither gives me enough reason to replace my current devices now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Show 5, Echo Dot and Fire TV devices repeat functions covered by the newer versions in my history, so familiarity alone does not make them useful purchases.",
    "The themed remote cover does not add a practical benefit that would make me switch from my Fire TV Stick 4K Max.",
    "The tablet and AirPods assume needs I have not expressed; buying Mac accessories does not mean I currently want another screen or personal listening gear."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated Echo and Fire TV purchases seem to be taken as interest in any device from those product lines, regardless of what I already have.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to be stretched into interest in loosely related gadgets without a clear use for them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The newer device generations in my recent history matter: an older version needs a specific additional purpose to interest me.",
    "My recent Echo Show stand purchase suggests I am equipping the display I already have, rather than looking to replace it.",
    "Useful additions and compatible accessories appeal more than duplicate devices; my frequent activity does not mean I need to replace equipment frequently."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa devices and practical peripherals, but overlook whether each item adds a useful capability to what I already have."
}
